description: Disable the Puppet agent with a message (puppet agent --disable) and wait for a run already under way to finish, so nothing applies a catalog while an operation changes the host. An agent that was already disabled is left as it is. Reports disabled_here: whether this task, or an earlier run of the same operation, is the one that disabled it, and so whether ovadm::agent_enable should enable it afterwards

message.description: Why the agent is disabled; puppet agent prints it when someone tries to run it (default: ovadm operation in progress)

reclaim.description: Treat an agent already disabled with a message that starts with this text as disabled by an earlier, interrupted run of the same operation: report disabled_here true, so it is enabled again at the end. Without it, any agent already disabled is the operator's

max_wait.description: Maximum seconds to wait for an agent run in progress before failing (default: 300)
